crew.overview: The murder of her father sends a teenage tomboy on a mission of 'justice', which involves avenging her father's death. She recruits a tough old marshal, 'Rooster' Cogburn because he has 'true grit', and a reputation of getting the job done.
crew.title: True Grit

details.biography:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Warren Low (born 1906; died in Woodland Hills, Los Angeles on July 27, 1989) was a noted American film editor who worked on Now, Voyager, Out of the Fog, and others. He was an originator for what became the American Cinema Editors and received awards from them.
details.name: Warren Low
